name: Ahead Innovation Labs
website_summary: Ahead Innovation Labs sells a generative simulation platform that creates synthetic market data and price paths for stress-testing investment models and strategies. It is aimed at institutional portfolio managers, risk teams, and quant researchers who want to test against scenarios not covered by historical data.

name: Aiera
website_summary: Aiera sells a permissioned AI platform that gives financial professionals — buy-side and sell-side firms — compliant access to broker research, expert transcripts, filings, and financial news through APIs, dashboards, and model context protocol integrations. It covers 13,000+ equities and 45,000+ public events annually, with content sourced from 11 major Wall Street banks.
linkedin_summary: Aiera recently launched what it calls the industry's first sell-side-validated AI content delivery platform, backed by a consortium of 10 major Wall Street banks, and closed a $25M Series B round with Microsoft as a strategic partner. The company also published AI performance research showing a 2.4x improvement in financial research tasks when models connect to its platform, and appointed Eric Lebovich as Head of Product Management.

name: Alphasense
website_summary: AlphaSense sells an AI-powered market intelligence and search platform that gives financial and corporate teams instant access to insights from 500M+ documents including earnings transcripts, broker research, filings, and expert interviews. It targets investment banks, hedge funds, private equity firms, asset managers, consultants, and large enterprises.
linkedin_summary: AlphaSense recently launched Sentiment Indices that convert executive and analyst language from earnings transcripts into quantifiable signals, and introduced SuperAnalyst, an always-on AI agent that autonomously handles research workflows and produces executive-ready reports. The company has also been hosting webinars on AI stacks for institutional investors and integrating with tools like Outlook, Slack, and Notion.

name: Batonics
website_summary: Batonics sells AI-powered tools for quantitative trading and investment analysis, including orderbook reconstruction, backtesting, risk modeling, and automated valuation engines, targeting hedge funds, HFT firms, real estate managers, and multi-asset family offices.
linkedin_summary: Batonics recently launched the Quantoscope, a Rust-based L3 orderbook reconstruction and feature engineering platform, and signed an MoU with Singapore's GAO Capital to build quant research infrastructure for proprietary trading algorithms. They also launched Loha AI, a formal verification tool for low-latency financial software.
